en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of pavilion-style buildings with ornate wooden gables and fences, set behind a lawn planted with small conifer trees and with hills in the background. Red Hungarian captions at the top read about a domestic industry exhibition and the national exhibition in Pécs. The reverse side is a typical early‑20th‑century divided back with Hungarian text, a 1907 postmark and stamp, and a circular cachet mentioning the Pécs national exhibition.
